items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: When I first saw it, nobody was living on there but she and Adam Clayton Powell.

ctx.x: Where did that thing start with Prez with the ladies?
Prez? Prez -- I think Lady named him. Billie Holiday named him the President and he called her -- he named her Lady Day.
But how did they start calling everybody else 'Lady'?
